notes.title: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve Patch #1 is available now!
notes.content:
A new update is available for [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i]! This patch includes various bug fixes and improvements.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused text boxes and bubbles to occasionally shrink, causing text to spill out
[*] Fixed minor visual issues with text bubbles across multiple scenes
[*] Fixed an issue that could allow multiple instances of the skill tree to be opened
[*] Fixed an issue that could lock the map if the player clicked on a second map location before the first one loaded
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause elements of the HUD and icons to flicker when hovering
[*] Adjusted the size of CRIT text in some languages
[*] Adjusted the offset for shield effects to prevent possible overlapping of adjacent enemies
[*] Fixed multiple issues related to missing killing a target during shield break
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the "No Holding Back" achievement from unlocking
[*] Fixed a softlock caused by trying to go to multiple unintended scenes
[*] Fixed an issue causing Killcannon's charged attack to have the wrong icon
[*] Fixed focus issues when using the menu on keyboard and mouse
[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060870



[h2]What is [i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve?[/i][/h2]
[i]Invincible Presents: Atom Eve[/i] is a visual novel with an original story, turn-based combat, and RPG elements. What that means is this is a game that lets you play as Atom Eve and you can make decisions that affect both Eve’s relationships with her friends and family and how events in the storyline play out. It’s our way to put you in control of your own Atom Eve comic book story.

Experience an original story with striking art directed by Rossi Gifford and creative direction by award-winning writer Jill Murray, and explore the life of Atom Eve in a world filled with beloved characters. Based on the comic book by Robert Kirkman, Cory Walker, and Ryan Ottley.
